scripts.bake:alley: npm run blender -- scripts/blender/alley.py -- .cache/polyhaven/models .cache/blender/alley_raw.glb src/scenes/alley/anchors.json && npm run bake:light
scripts.bake:light: npm run blender -- scripts/blender/alley_bake.py -- .cache/blender/alley.blend src/scenes/alley/anchors.json .cache/blender/bake 512 && gltf-transform optimize .cache/blender/bake/alley_lit.glb public/scenes/alley_lit.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 512 --simplify false --prune-attributes false && python3 scripts/lightmaps.py .cache/blender/bake/alley_lightmap.png public/scenes/alley_lightmap.webp && python3 scripts/lightmaps.py .cache/blender/bake/ground_lightmap.png public/scenes/ground_lightmap.webp 2 && cp .cache/blender/bake/ground.json src/scenes/alley/ground.json
scripts.rig:lamp: npm run blender -- scripts/blender/lamp_rig.py -- .cache/polyhaven/models/desk_lamp_arm_01/desk_lamp_arm_01.gltf .cache/blender/desk_lamp_rig.glb && gltf-transform optimize .cache/blender/desk_lamp_rig.glb public/models/desk_lamp_rig.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --join false --flatten false
scripts.hdri:small: npm run blender -- scripts/blender/hdri_small.py -- public/hdri/shanghai_bund.hdr public/hdri/studio_small_09.hdr
scripts.rig:camera: npm run blender -- scripts/blender/camera_rig.py -- .cache/polyhaven/models/security_camera_01/security_camera_01.gltf .cache/blender/security_camera_rig.glb && gltf-transform optimize .cache/blender/security_camera_rig.glb public/models/security_camera_rig.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 512 --join false --flatten false
